capabilities: Convert clipboard HTML to Markdown on paste
Fetch page titles for bare URLs and turn them into Markdown links
Strip tracking parameters from pasted URLs
Normalize whitespace and line endings in pasted text
Pass through pastes inside code blocks, frontmatter, and image pastes unmodified
extras: States a 5-second timeout with fallback to the plain URL when a page title cannot be fetched; custom tracking parameters can be configured in settings.
problem: Pasting from web pages and rich editors into Obsidian leaves messy HTML, untitled bare URLs, tracking parameters, and excessive whitespace that must be cleaned by hand.
summary: Paste interceptor that converts clipboard HTML to Markdown, fetches titles for bare URLs, strips tracking parameters, and normalizes whitespace.
